variants.prompt: A captivating young woman with fiery auburn tresses flowing freely, eyes smoldering with desire beneath long, lustrous lashes, reclines seductively in a yacht's luxurious stateroom. Her warm, sun-kissed skin seems to glow with a soft, ethereal light. She wears a daring leather bodysuit hugging every curve, paired with black lace panties, thigh-high boots, and chandelier earrings. A bold red lip and tousled hair frame her sultry expression as she lounges on the plush bed, one leg casually draped, captured in a cinematic full-body shot from slightly above.
